title: Greywater Tank Fill and Pumpout Balance
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), water pressure (`waterpressure:reading`), irrigation control (`irrigation:zone`), water-heater events (`waterheater:event`), greywater tanks (`greywater:tank`), and utility sensors for pumps and softeners (`sumppump:event`, `wellpump:event`, `watersoftener:status`).
app: Water and plumbing telemetry from smart water meters, pressure sensors, irrigation controllers, sump and well pumps, greywater tanks, and water-heater sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=greywater:tank
| timechart span=1d sum(inflow_liters) as inflow_liters sum(pumpout_liters) as pumpout_liters
| eval balance_liters=inflow_liters-pumpout_liters
description: Tracks whether the greywater system is accumulating more volume than it is pumping or reusing.
value: Balance over time shows whether storage and reuse are matched or whether the system is quietly trending toward overflow.
implementation: Send level, inflow, and pumpout metrics from the greywater tank controller or level sensors.
visualization: Time chart of daily inflow, pumpout, and net balance.
grandmaExplanation: It measures whether your greywater tank is filling faster than it is being emptied, which helps prevent messy surprises.
